Accessory rewards require 1,200 KVM points for each.

[Logistics]
Kreiger Weapons are LV 4 Weapons, they can be upgraded and will have special effects: Slaughter, Destruction and Blessing.

[Logistics]
When you can wear all 3 armors, you can have a special set of options.
Also, when Kreiger Accessory rewards are worn with medalsm it will bring you special set rewards.

[Logistics]

Players whose Lvl is higher than 60 can equip Mass-Production Armors and there is a Lvl limit for Popularized Armor as well.
